professional.label: Professional
professional.description: Courteous and formal tone, ideal for B2B or medical services.
professional.example: We thank you for your feedback and remain at your disposal.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Warm and personal tone, perfect for restaurants and hotels.
warm.example: Thank you so much for these kind words that touch us! Your visit was a pleasure.

casual.label: Casual
casual.description: Relaxed and friendly tone, suitable for local businesses.
casual.example: So glad you enjoyed it! See you soon!

luxury.label: Luxury / Premium
luxury.description: Refined and elegant tone, for high-end establishments.
luxury.example: We are honored by your testimonial and hope to have the privilege of welcoming you again.

dynamic.label: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Energetic and enthusiastic tone, ideal for sports and leisure.
dynamic.example: Awesome! Your positive energy motivates us! Can't wait to see you again for new adventures!

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: 4-5 sentences, balance between conciseness and personalization.

empathetic.label: Empathetic
empathetic.description: Show empathy, apologize sincerely and acknowledge the problem.

solution.label: Solution-oriented
solution.description: Propose a concrete solution or explain corrective measures taken.

contact.label: Contact invitation
contact.description: Invite the customer to contact us directly to resolve the issue.

factual.label: Factual
factual.description: Respond factually, clarify if necessary, remain neutral.

reconquest.label: Win-back
reconquest.description: Offer compensation or an invitation to return for a better experience.

language.title: Language
language.description: Select your preferred language for the interface

platforms.title: Connected Platforms
platforms.subtitle: Connect your accounts to automatically sync your reviews
platforms.apiSectionDescription: Connect your Google and Facebook accounts to automatically fetch reviews and publish replies.
platforms.noLocationsDescription: Create a location first to configure platform connections.
